Table 2. KL divergence of predicted distributions against groundtruth annotation Betas on RECOLA and SEWA. U : Uniform baseline; B: true Beta distribution. Lower values indicate closer match to annotator distributions.

Figure 1. Framework Overview: (a) annotator signals form a probabilistic consensus (µ, σ); (b) multimodal features are mapped to these parameters during training; (c) at test time, predicted (µ, σ) define a Beta distribution capturing annotation ambiguity.
